definitions.explanation: The practice of cutting away dead or overgrown branches or stems to promote healthy growth and maintain the shape of plants and trees.

examples.english: I pruned the trees in the garden.
It's best to do pruning in winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{剪定|せんてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I asked a craftsman to prune the pine tree.

notes:
{剪定|せんてい} refers to the practice of pruning plants and trees.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {剪定|せんてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to prune)
- {剪定|せんてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to carry out pruning)
- ⟦{剪定|せんてい}ばさみ→剪定ばさみ：29573_senteibasami⟧ (pruning shears)

TYPES OF PRUNING:
- ⟦{強剪定|つよせんてい}→強剪定：noentry⟧ (heavy pruning)
- ⟦{軽剪定|かるせんてい}→軽剪定：noentry⟧ (light pruning)
- ⟦{透|す}かし{剪定|せんてい}→透かし剪定：noentry⟧ (thinning cuts)
- ⟦{切|き}り{戻|もど}し→切り戻し：noentry⟧ (cutting back)

TOOLS:
- ⟦{剪定|せんてい}ばさみ→剪定ばさみ：29573_senteibasami⟧ (pruning shears)
- ⟦{剪定|せんてい}のこぎり→剪定のこぎり：noentry⟧ (pruning saw)
- ⟦{高枝切|たかえだき}りばさみ→高枝切りばさみ：noentry⟧ (pole pruner)

GARDENING NOTE:
In Japan, pine tree (⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧) pruning is a specialized skill, and professional gardeners (⟦{植木屋|うえきや}→植木屋：29574_uekiya⟧) are often hired for this work.
